focus: ZCode: hooks, tool names, install/update/rollback, compaction path, deny/rewrite/replace, subagent handling, project source, skills, v1 footprint

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC.md live-E2E row for ZCode still names the wrong config file, so the ZCode G25 hook-firing test cannot run as written.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:369 says 'project-root `zcode.json`' as the ZCode live-run config target. docs/v2/review/REVIEW-r2.md:138 already flagged this exact line: 'ZCode live-E2E row uses project-root zcode.json, but ZCode ignores hooks in project config, so the G25 hook probe cannot fire.' tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md:43 confirms: '~/.zcode/cli/config.json ... project hooks ignored.' The r2 fix ('use a temp HOME with ~/.zcode/cli/config.json') was never applied; TECH-SPEC:369 is unchanged two rounds later and REVIEW-r4a.md does not mention it.
findings.fix: Change TECH-SPEC §6 ZCode row to a temp HOME with ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (hooks.enabled:true, hooks.events.<Event>), not project-root zcode.json. Update the GS3/G25 release job and the S-ZCODE spike target to match.

findings.claim: ADR-0011's v1 cleanup table says ZCode has no v1 footprint, but the owner's own evidence shows v1 was run on ZCode and left files behind.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0011-release-and-v1-transition.md:71: 'ZCode | none | —'. tickets/data/is.json and isall.json, issue #1268 title: '[Feature]: Add native ZCode adapter — its hook schema is Claude Code-compatible (verified working via codex adapter)' — i.e. real users already ran v1 configured through the Codex adapter shape to reach ZCode. ADR-0011:62 (Codex row) lists a real v1 footprint for that adapter shape (hooks.json entries, config.toml mcp_servers section, data dir). This was already flagged in REVIEW-r2.md:162 ('ZCode: v1 footprint none is wrong — #1268 shows users ran v1 on ZCode through the Codex adapter') and is still unfixed in the current ADR-0011.
findings.fix: Add a ZCode row to the v1 cleanup table pointing at the Codex-shaped config path ZCode users actually used (per #1268), e.g. scan ~/.zcode/cli/config.json / plugin hooks.json for a context-mode-tagged entry written via the Codex-compatible path, and report it (don't claim zero footprint).

findings.claim: ADR-0016's per-agent table states flatly that ZCode's PreToolUse supports Case B input-rewrite ('rewrite supported'), but the project's own live-hook spike marks ZCode's output/rewrite capability as unverified DOCS-only, same evidentiary gap already used to downgrade ZCode's Case A entry.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0016-subagent-context-protection.md per-agent table, ZCode row: 'Case B (rewrite): rewrite supported' stated as fact. tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md §2 ZCode section: 'Output: Claude fields' is listed only by analogy to Claude Code's output shape, status DOCS, with 'Live: not possible' and the MCP-firing column marked UNKNOWN; §4 lists 'ZCode: resume source; default timeout wording' still as an open unknown. REVIEW-r4a.md:61 (finding #27) already downgrades ZCode's Case A to [U] on this same evidence but only addresses Case A, leaving the Case B 'rewrite supported' claim in the same table uncorrected.
findings.fix: Tag ZCode's Case B cell as [U] (DOCS-only, no live verification that ZCode's PreToolUse output honors a Claude-Code-style updatedInput equivalent) alongside the Case A fix in finding #27, pending S-ZCODE/GP-LIVE-HOOKS; do not present it as settled fact in the adapter table used to drive GP3 golden cases.

findings.claim: ADR-0016's ZCode row claims Case C (large-output replace) falls back to deny with a Read offset/limit or Grep output_mode:count alternative, but ZCode's actual builtin tool names are undocumented anywhere in the reviewed docs, so the deny's named alternative may not exist on ZCode.
findings.evidence: docs/v2/TECH-SPEC.md:397 S-NAMES spike: 'Exact MCP tool names on Copilot CLI, Kiro, ZCode' is still listed as an open spike, never resolved. ADR-0016's Case C fallback for ZCode names Read `offset`/`limit` and Grep `output_mode:"count"` as if ZCode ships Claude-Code-named builtins, but TECH-SPEC itself treats ZCode's tool names as unknown.
findings.fix: Either confirm ZCode's builtin tool names and parameter support for offset/limit and output_mode before shipping the Case C fallback, or mark the ZCode Case C alternative [U] until S-NAMES resolves.

unverified: zc-3 and zc-4 depend on resolving S-ZCODE / S-NAMES; no live ZCode session was available this round (consistent with tickets/spike-hooks-verified.md: 'Live: not possible').
